messages.content: What is supervised fine-tuning?
Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) trains a pretrained language model on labeled prompt-response pairs so it follows instructions more reliably.
Explain full-parameter fine-tuning in one sentence.
Full-parameter fine-tuning updates every weight in the model, which is expressive but memory- and compute-heavy.
When should I prefer fullparams over LoRA?
Prefer fullparams when you need maximum adaptation capacity, have enough GPU memory, and want the strongest possible task fit.
Rewrite this more clearly: 'Model train good with data.'
The model trains well when the dataset is clean and well formatted.
List three signs of a good chat dataset.

1) Clear user intents
2) Helpful assistant replies
3) Consistent roles and formatting across rows
Convert Celsius 25 to Fahrenheit.
What does temperature control in text generation?
Temperature scales next-token randomness: lower values are more deterministic, higher values are more diverse.
Give a short polite refusal to a request for private passwords.
I can't help with obtaining or guessing private passwords. If you need account access, use the official reset flow.
Summarize: Fine-tuning adapts a base model to a domain using task examples.
Fine-tuning specializes a base model with task-specific examples.
Write a one-line commit message for adding dataset upload validation.
Validate uploaded datasets before queueing processing jobs.
What is a chat template?
A chat template converts role-tagged messages into the exact token format a model expects during training and inference.
Name two metrics useful after instruction tuning.
Instruction-following quality on held-out prompts, and reference-aware scores such as exact match or loss on target answers.
Fix the grammar: 'Them models is learning fast.'
Those models are learning fast.
Why keep sequences short for a 270M smoke test?
Short sequences fit small GPUs, reduce OOM risk, and still verify the training pipeline end to end.
Produce a JSON object with keys name and status for a completed job.
{"name": "mock-fullparams", "status": "COMPLETED"}
What column does this OpenAI-style dataset use?
It uses a messages column with role/content turns, which SFT recipes normalize into text via the chat template.
Give an example system-style tip for concise answers.
Answer directly first, then add at most one supporting sentence.
Is JSON array upload supported for datasets?
Yes. Upload a JSON file containing an array of objects, then wait for the data-processor audit to complete.
Translate to French: Good morning.
Bonjour.
What batch size should I start with on a 4GB GPU?
Start with batch size 1 and a short max sequence length, then increase only if memory allows.
Define overfitting in fine-tuning.
Overfitting means the model memorizes training examples and generalizes poorly to new prompts.
Return only the capital of Japan.
Tokyo
Why use instruction-response pairs for fullparams?
They teach the model to map natural-language requests to useful completions across all weights.
Write a tiny Python function that adds two integers.

def add(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a + b
